questions.question: What does HTML stand for?
questions.explanation: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language.

questions.question: Which element represents the largest heading?
questions.explanation: h1 is the highest-level HTML heading.

questions.question: Which element is used for a paragraph?
questions.explanation: The p element represents a paragraph.

questions.question: Which attribute specifies the destination of a link?
questions.explanation: The href attribute specifies the URL of a hyperlink.

questions.question: Which element creates a hyperlink?
questions.explanation: The a element creates hyperlinks.

questions.question: Which attribute specifies an image source?
questions.explanation: The src attribute specifies the image resource.

questions.question: Why is the alt attribute used with images?
questions.explanation: alt provides alternative text for an image.

questions.question: Which element creates an unordered list?
questions.explanation: ul creates an unordered list.

questions.question: Which element represents an item inside a list?
questions.explanation: li represents a list item.

questions.question: Which element represents the main content of a page?
questions.explanation: The main element represents the dominant content of the document.

questions.question: Which element is used for navigation links?
questions.explanation: The nav element represents navigation links.

questions.question: Which element is used to create a table row?
questions.explanation: tr represents a table row.

questions.question: Which element represents a table header cell?
questions.explanation: th represents a header cell.

questions.question: Which element is used to create a form?
questions.explanation: The form element defines an HTML form.

questions.question: Which input type is appropriate for an email address?
questions.explanation: input type="email" is intended for email addresses.

questions.question: Which element creates a submit button?
questions.explanation: A button with type submit can submit a form.

questions.question: Where is the page title normally defined?
questions.explanation: The title element belongs in the document head.

questions.question: Which element can embed video in modern HTML?
questions.explanation: HTML provides the video element for video content.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of semantic HTML?
options: To describe the meaning and structure of content
questions.explanation: Semantic elements communicate the meaning and structure of content.

questions.question: What is the main role of HTML in web development?
questions.explanation: HTML provides the structure of web pages.
